# cosmoner_resource_group (Resource)

A group that resources are drawn inside on the project graph. Groups change layout only, never what a resource does.

Deleting a group moves whatever was inside it up a level; no resource is deleted with it.

Needs `projects:read` and `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmoner_resource_group" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

resource "cosmoner_resource_group" "backend" {
  name      = "Backend"
  parent_id = cosmoner_resource_group.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `parent_id` (String) ID of the group this one is drawn inside. Omit for a top-level group.
- `project_id` (String) Project the resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<group_id>, or just <group_id> when the provider sets a project.
terraform import cosmoner_resource_group.production proj_123/clx0group
```
